title: Machine Learning

units.title: Introduction & Linear Regression
units.topics: Linear regression, cost function, gradient descent, polynomial regression, regularization (Ridge & Lasso).

units.title: Decision Trees & Ensemble Methods

units.title: Unsupervised Learning & Clustering

units.title: Transaction Processing

units.topics: IPv4 vs IPv6, CIDR, Subnetting, ARP, DHCP, ICMP protocol.

units.title: Routing Algorithms & Protocols

units.title: Transport Layer Protocols

units.title: Application Layer & Security

Computer Networks - Andrew S. Tanenbaum

Data Structures using C - Reema Thareja

title: Digital Signal Processing (DSP)

units.topics: Sampling theorem, Nyquist rate, aliasing, linearity, time-invariance, convolution sum.
